validationOwner.simulation: MovementValidation, MovementValidationRequest, MovementValidationResult, MovementValidator (the only producer of VALID/UNCERTAIN/INVALID); additive ReconstructionResult.Diagnostics / InputReconstructor accounting / InputDomain.describeHistory
validationOwner.core: MovementValidationRunner, ContextObservationMapper, ValidationStatus, ValidationEngineStatus, PacketEngine composition

validationCore: MovementValidator.validate = TimingReconstruction.run once + classify (pure); classify(request, result) for a caller holding the union; the rule: explaining step -> VALID; else any incomplete/unsupported dimension -> UNCERTAIN naming each; else INVALID with proof; enforced again by MovementValidationResult's constructor

semantics.VALID: at least one explaining step (exact Phase 6 candidate under some timing hypothesis, or a correction application point); ambiguity fine; reasons LEGAL_INPUT_FOUND/LEGAL_TIMING_BRANCH_FOUND/EXTERNAL_MOTION_EXPLAINS/TELEPORT_APPLICATION_POINT; witnesses <= 4
semantics.UNCERTAIN: 27 typed reasons (CLIMBABLE_CONTACT added in the decision pass), every missing dimension named separately; residual diagnostics attached; nextFrontierComplete=false
semantics.INVALID: completeness.all() && 0 legal candidates && no uncertainty; NO_LEGAL_INPUT + HORIZONTAL_EXCESS/VERTICAL_EXCESS/IMPOSSIBLE_ASCENT/IMPOSSIBLE_DESCENT/COLLISION_PENETRATION/UNEXPLAINED_DISPLACEMENT from the exhausted set; Proof(hypothesesExhausted, reconstructions, evaluations, rawEnumerated, excludedExact, excludedEnvelope, candidatesRemaining=0, profiles, epoch/revision, hypothesis ids)

completenessProof: Completeness(timing, reconstruction, world, attributes, effects, equipment, entities, border, externalMotion, mechanicSupported, search, observation, frontier) derived per dimension from TimingResolution statuses, ReconstructionResult.Coverage reasons and the adapter notes; frontier flag travels with the chain, re-set by an absolute correction application point or a rest re-anchor
timingUnion: every TimingResolution status consumed (RESOLVED_UNIQUE/AMBIGUOUS/NO_ACK_EVIDENCE/INSUFFICIENT_RTT complete unless flagged; TIMING_GAP, SEARCH_LIMIT, UNSUPPORTED_HORIZON, TELEPORT_UNRESOLVED, WORLD/SESSION_DISCONTINUITY, EXTERNAL_MOTION_UNRESOLVED, EXPIRED, UNSUPPORTED -> named UNCERTAIN reasons); RTT never used; timing corpus 16 610 transmissions VALID
reconstructionUnion: TimingReconstruction.run unions every hypothesis's Phase 6 continuations (dedup by state+pending set); the chain carries next() forward; witnesses from exact candidates with history counts; no InputReconstructor call outside the adapter
externalMotion: velocity SET / explosion ADD branches from Phase 7; EXTERNAL_MOTION_EXPLAINS; unresolved/expired/overflow -> UNCERTAIN; P8-F4: applied influences retired from the live scope once no continuation has them pending (and after the profile horizon)
teleportSafety: application point VALID (TELEPORT_APPLICATION_POINT, no physics step); absolute correction re-anchors the chain (6 nodes: poses x ground, velocity = delta); pre-application movement ordinary (fixture valid_pre_application_reminder); outstanding correction across the interval TELEPORT_UNRESOLVED; respawn/world change DISCONTINUITY; epoch mismatch never VALID (property test)

locomotion.supported: walk, sprint, sneak, strafe, jump, fall, collisions, step-up, slabs, stairs, fences/walls, ice, slime, honey, soul sand, ladders, crawling pose, knockback/velocity, explosions, corrections
locomotion.unsupported -> UNCERTAIN: fluids/bubble columns (UNSUPPORTED_FLUID), elytra / creative or spectator / flight-capable context (UNSUPPORTED_LOCOMOTION, runner refuses), vehicles, powder snow with unknown equipment, entity pushing with a relevant entity within 4 blocks (ENTITY_NEIGHBORHOOD_UNKNOWN), levitation/slow falling, in-block push-out, >3-tick horizons, unknown game mode; climbable block within reach (CLIMBABLE_CONTACT, P8-F2): VALID when explained, never INVALID

zeroFalseInvalidGate.gate: >= 95% VALID per supported benign class, 0 INVALID

impossibleCorpus.observationModel: exact double equality for transmitted positions (MovementObservationProfile.PAPER_26_2): any shift from every legal prediction, including one ulp, lies outside the reachable observation set in a complete context

speedControlledTests: horizontal x1.01/x1.05/x1.1/x1.2/x1.5/x2.0 (250 each): 250/250 INVALID at every factor; live injections 0.31/0.42/0.5 per tick: INVALID (UNEXPLAINED_DISPLACEMENT inside the legal extent at 0.31, HORIZONTAL_EXCESS at 0.42 and 0.5 against legal h<=0.3274 from rest)
flyControlledTests: upward +0.05/+0.2/+0.5/+1.0 (250 each), hover 20/20, no-gravity 20/20, step +0.7 250/250, through-floor 250/250: all INVALID; fixture invalid_hover; live injections +0.05/tick drift, +0.1 hold, +1.0, -0.5 into the floor (COLLISION_PENETRATION), +0.7 step: INVALID
uncertainClasses: search-limit (property test + fixture uncertain_search_limit + live honey->soul sand step), unknown world (fixture + engine test: WORLD_INCOMPLETE, chain re-anchors), unsupported fluid (fixture + live water step: UNSUPPORTED_FLUID), unknown attribute/effects/entities/border (property test: adding uncertainty never yields INVALID), teleport discontinuity, epoch mismatch, frontier incomplete, capture-only/coverage break -> CAPTURE_GAP / anchor drop

properties: every VALID witness reproduces the observation
INVALID only with completeness.all(), 0 candidates, a proof and hypothesesExhausted == steps
adding uncertainty (frontier flag, content flag, attributes/entities/border/effects UNKNOWN) never yields INVALID
search exhaustion never INVALID; world-epoch mismatch never VALID

memory.bounds: event slice <= 1024 events, recent ring 48 lines, injected ring 48 lines, one last result, frontier <= TimingBudget.DEFAULT.maxFrontierNodes() nodes; no per-transmission history, no UUID-labelled metric; attributes <= 32, effects <= 32, tracked entities <= 1024 (beyond the bound the neighbourhood is UNKNOWN, never dropped silently)

jmh.setup: JMH 1.37, Temurin 25, 3 forks, 5x1 s warm-up, 10x1 s measurement, -prof gc, one host, descriptive

diagnosticCommand: /papea2ac validate <player> [view | recent | notable | inject dx dy dz [ticks]]; status line: validation requests/VALID/UNCERTAIN/INVALID, uncertain families, timingBranches, reconstructions, evaluations, anchors/lost, internalErrors, injected
threading: runner owned by the session shard thread (assertOwner); platform reads a volatile immutable ValidationStatus; inject under the runner monitor; no main-thread pipeline; exceptions contained (UNCERTAIN/INTERNAL_ERROR, anchor drop, counter)
sessionAndEpochSafety: replacement session -> fresh runner and ledger (engine test); Discontinuity/CoverageBreak -> anchor drop, slice and influences cleared, side chain ended; epoch mismatch never VALID
realClientLegitimateQualification: see PHASE_8_IMPLEMENTATION.md REAL CLIENT QUALIFICATION and docs/phase8-artifacts/real-client-evidence.log

phase9Implementation: NONE (no VL, alert, setback, punishment, accumulation, check object or configuration anywhere; architecture test)
knownLimitations: exact-double observation model: any transmitted position outside the exact reachable set is INVALID in a complete context
anchoring needs a confirmed absolute correction or a 20-tick rest fixed point; unknown-world / unsupported-mechanic / lost-continuation steps drop the anchor until then
relevant entity within 4 blocks or incomplete tracker -> UNCERTAIN (no entity pushing model)
equipment never known (only matters on powder snow)
fluids and the other unsupported mechanics make transitions UNCERTAIN
SEARCH_LIMIT next to WORLD_INCOMPLETE is a consequence of the incompleteness (metric precedence puts the world first)
side-chain injection drops markers and pending influences (sound: wider union)
climbable blocks within reach (ladders, vines, scaffolding) are explained (VALID) but never INVALID (CLIMBABLE_CONTACT, P8-F2) until the ladder/sideways-input model discrepancy is located in Phase 5
